result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom navigation all render consistently. Two visual defects stand out: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation lacks an icon (its label floats without one while the other three tabs have icons), and the right-edge category chip is clipped with no fade/scroll affordance. Excluded per instructions: the partially visible carousel card at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom of the viewport.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab shows only a text label with no icon above it, while 'Home', 'Search' and 'Profile' each have an icon. This leaves an awkward empty gap and makes the tab look broken/inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing orders icon (e.g. a receipt/bag glyph) above the 'Orders' label, matching the size, spacing and inactive gray color of the other tab icons.

issues.description: The horizontally scrollable category chip row ends with a chip that is cut off abruptly at the right screen edge with no visual affordance (fade gradient or peeking padding), which can look like a rendering glitch rather than intentional scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade mask or slight edge padding/scroll indicator so the clipped chip reads as scrollable content instead of a layout error.

issues.description: The notification bell button in the top-right uses a very light gray circle on a near-white background, giving low contrast for the control boundary; only the small red dot signals state.
issues.suggestion: Slightly darken the button background or add a subtle border/shadow so the tappable area is perceivable, keeping the red badge for unread notifications.
